name: The person's memory settings
about: docs/api/memory-v1.md, 'The switch, and the grants': the grants are off by default, a change is the additive event `memory_switched`, and the settings round-trip through GET/PUT /api/me/memory-settings. Memory is off until the person turns it on, one switch per agent (ADR 0091, the owner's answer to ANR-Q59, 2026-11-24).

cases.name: a person who never touched memory has no grants
enabling one agent leaves the others off
a read-only grant is asymmetric on purpose

expect.note: read: true with write: false is the shape a person gives an agent they want to consult memory but never change it

cases.name: turning it back off is the same call, and it keeps nothing pending

expect.note: with no approval step there is nothing to expire or discard when a grant goes away (ADR 0091 decision 2)

cases.name: another person's settings are not visible

expect.note: the route is the caller's own data (ADR 0039); there is no route to another person's

cases.name: a malformed grant is refused, and nothing is written
